mostWorthwhile.text: Reporting the open door as June's observation, then publishing it with its source and time, made the difference between evidence and a sensor reading concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the unknown-state display yielded no partners and didn't help advance the goal, although it was a reasonable check.

surprise.text: The disconnected sensor produced an honest unknown status rather than a false closed reading; a manual observation could then supplement it without pretending the sensor worked.

arbitrary.text: The power bank initially had no available combination until the owner authorized the controller. Authorization was meaningful, but that ordering was not obvious from the visible pieces.

continue.text: I would continue: the independent key and the carefully sourced status page made the neighborhood network feel like a practical problem with more to discover, despite a few unclear combination requirements.
